title: Uruguayan Haggis Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bowl dish combining the savory taste of Uruguayan beef with the traditional Scottish haggis.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Uruguayan beef and cook until browned.
Add the haggis and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beef broth and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spoon the mixture into the nourishing bowl and serve.
